title: Allowance Savings-Goal Progress by Child
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allowance:txn
| search goal_pct=*
| stats latest(goal_pct) as goal_pct latest(balance) as balance by child_name
| sort 0 - goal_pct
description: Ranks childrens by allowance savings progress.
value: Goal progress makes the allowance data useful for coaching patience rather than only logging transactions.
implementation: Send allowance savings progress events to `index=personal` and keep `child_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of allowance savings progress by children.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which childrens stand out most for allowance savings progress.
